title: PADataset workspace-control v2 integration
goal: Adopt the promoted workspace-control v2 operating model in PADataset with the smallest project-local integration necessary for durable cold starts, direct-tool-first execution, executor handoff, and task-state recovery while preserving PADataset-owned scientific/domain authority and existing research workflows.
acceptance_criteria: PADataset exposes a clear root route into the shared workspace-control v2 operator contract while preserving PADataset-owned scientific and workflow authority.
Any project-local ChatGPT/Codex adapter remains thin and does not duplicate or fork generic workspace-control semantics.

A fresh ChatGPT or Codex session can start from PADataset README.md on the integration branch, recover the shared control-plane route and relevant project-local context, and identify the next safe action without prior conversation state.
The integration preserves the existing PADataset task-routing model and does not alter scientific code, experiment behavior, dataset semantics, result provenance, or paper claims.
Direct GitHub/tool execution remains the default surface; local runtime is introduced only when validation genuinely requires local computation or environment state.
Any required local validation uses isolated/safe worktree mechanics and does not switch, clean, reset, stash, or otherwise disturb existing user worktrees.
The final integration diff is explicitly reviewed and contains only justified control-plane/routing/adapter documentation changes.
The PADataset integration branch ends at a verified durable checkpoint and the v2 task is HANDOFF_SAFE.
The authoritative JSON capsule and maintained Markdown cold-start handoff remain synchronized after every material task-state mutation.
constraints: Start from PADataset README.md at control-plane-v2-integration@232d5fd506ac8bffa55c39591c9cf1198257e51f and follow its existing task routes; do not recursively inventory unrelated repository areas.
Do not mutate research-framework as part of this task; all PADataset project changes belong on control-plane-v2-integration unless the capsule is explicitly revised.
Preserve PADataset as the authority for RF/DQNGuard research, executable behavior, datasets, experiments, results, papers, and project-specific context.
Do not copy generic workspace-control policy into PADataset. Route to the shared contract and keep any local adapter project-specific and thin.
Do not modify scientific source code, experiment configuration, generated data, result artifacts, manuscript claims, or accepted-paper snapshots merely to complete control-plane adoption.
Do not perform opportunistic cleanup, broad context rewrites, branch switching, stash/reset/clean operations, or unrelated repository maintenance.
Before expanding mutation scope into executable/configuration paths, update this capsule with the demonstrated need and preserve JSON-to-Markdown synchronization.
Use direct GitHub tooling for remotely provable operations; use local/runtime execution only for evidence that cannot be established remotely.
Treat generated task Markdown as the standard pasteable cold-start handoff surface; regenerate it from the post-mutation JSON before any further task operation or handoff.
